_approval: Owner approved 2026-10-12 ("Approved"), P1 Ruling 6. Drafted from career-target descriptions, share-weighted O*NET 31.0 Importance for the alumni entry mixes (Customer and Personal Service, Sales and Marketing, Administration and Management, Persuasion/Negotiation), and the existing catalog to avoid overlap. Enter the catalog unlinked with origin = gc_authored; linking to targets comes with weights after P2.

competencies.name: Customer relationship and service
competencies.knowDescriptor: Knows service standards, how client problems are escalated, and what keeps accounts over the long term.
competencies.understandDescriptor: Understands why handling a mistake well often builds more trust than never making one, and why keeping a client costs less than winning a new one.
competencies.doDescriptor: Manages a client through a problem (a missed date, a quality issue) to a recorded resolution, and keeps a relationship record others can pick up.
competencies.rationale: Customer and Personal Service is a top-three O*NET knowledge area by share-weighted Importance for all five targets' entry occupations. Boundary: first discovery of what the client needs stays in client-needs-diagnosis.

competencies.name: Negotiation and persuasion
competencies.knowDescriptor: Knows the basics of negotiation: interests versus positions, walk-away points, and the levers of price, terms and scope.
competencies.understandDescriptor: Understands why the best deal protects both the margin and the relationship.
competencies.doDescriptor: Prepares and conducts a negotiation, real or simulated, over price, scope or terms, and documents the outcome against the walk-away point.
competencies.rationale: Persuasion and Negotiation rank highly for the Sales Solutions & Account Management and Brand Strategy & Experience entry occupations. Boundary: writing the proposal stays in proposal-development.

competencies.name: Business and financial literacy
competencies.knowDescriptor: Knows how a print, packaging or marketing business makes money: revenue, cost of goods, gross margin, overhead and pricing models.
competencies.understandDescriptor: Understands how a decision on a job (a discount, a rush, a reprint) moves the profit and loss, and why volume is not profit.
competencies.doDescriptor: Reads a simple profit-and-loss or job-costing report and explains, with numbers, whether a job or an account is worth keeping.
competencies.rationale: Administration and Management and Mathematics carry high Importance across the mixes; no current competency covers how the firm itself makes money. Boundary: estimating a single job stays in cost-management; the buyer's ROI case stays in proposal-development.

competencies.name: Contracts, IP and licensing
competencies.knowDescriptor: Knows basic contract terms (scope, payment, liability, change orders) and the rules for copyright, trademarks, font and image licensing, and rights in AI-generated content.
competencies.understandDescriptor: Understands why rights problems surface late, when they cost the most, and who carries the risk in a client–vendor chain.
competencies.doDescriptor: Reviews a job's assets and agreement, and identifies and resolves the licensing and contract risks before release.
competencies.rationale: GC work routinely handles licensed fonts, images and, increasingly, AI-generated content for clients; no current competency covers rights and contract risk.
